label: Access to Ysgramor's Tomb
description: Reach the Companions quest stage that opens Ysgramor's Tomb.

label: Access to Snow Veil Sanctum
description: Reach the Thieves Guild quest stage that opens Snow Veil Sanctum.

label: Access to Dustman's Cairn
description: Reach the Companions quest stage that opens Dustman's Cairn.

label: Access to Saarthal
description: Reach the College quest stage that permits entry to Saarthal.

label: Access to Korvanjund
description: Reach The Jagged Crown quest stage that permits entry to Korvanjund.

label: Access to Dead Men's Respite
description: Begin Tending the Flames and obtain access to Dead Men's Respite.

label: Access to Dimhollow Crypt
description: Reach the Dawnguard quest stage that opens Dimhollow Crypt.

label: Access to the Forgotten Vale
description: Reach Touching the Sky and enter the Forgotten Vale.

label: Access to the Soul Cairn and Durnehviir
description: Reach Beyond Death and defeat Durnehviir in the Soul Cairn.

label: Access to Vahlok's Tomb
description: Begin Lost Legacy after satisfying its Solstheim prerequisites.

label: Access to Kolbjorn Barrow depths
description: Advance Unearthed until the word wall is accessible.

label: Access through Bloodskal Barrow
description: Advance The Final Descent through Bloodskal Barrow.

label: Access to the Temple of Miraak
description: Advance the Dragonborn questline into the Temple of Miraak.

label: Access to Waking Dreams in Apocrypha
description: Reach At the Summit of Apocrypha and traverse Waking Dreams.

label: Hermaeus Mora grants Bend Will — Mind
description: Reach The Gardener of Men acquisition in Apocrypha.

label: Hermaeus Mora grants Bend Will — Dragon
description: Complete the Skaal knowledge exchange that grants the final word.

label: Sapphire Dragon Claw reward is available
description: Complete Wilhelm's investigation of Shroud Hearth Barrow and receive the Sapphire Dragon Claw.

label: The Forsworn Conspiracy has started
description: Enter Markarth and begin The Forsworn Conspiracy so Vigilant Tyranus can appear.

label: Blindsighted access to Irkngthand
description: Advance the Thieves Guild quest Blindsighted until the Skeleton Key can be acquired in Irkngthand.

label: Current Companions lycanthropy
description: The player currently has Beast Blood. Correct this manually when Skyrim state changes outside the authored Companions tasks.

label: Personal purification is currently available
description: Available immediately after Kodlak's purification, or later after both Farkas and Vilkas have completed Purity.
